questions.q: Who was the first Roman emperor?
questions.model: The timeline says 27 BC. That is when Rome got its first emperor. His name was Augustus.

questions.q: About how many soldiers were in a legion?
Name one weapon a legionary carried.
Label a Roman soldier's kit sheet (shield, sword, spear, helmet, armour, sandals) and write what each was for. Objects only.
questions.a: Each item labelled with a use, e.g. scutum: protection
questions.model: Teacher labels the scutum first: 'protects the body'.

questions.q: Write two reasons the Roman army was hard to beat.
questions.a: Training and discipline; good equipment; teamwork such as the tortoise

questions.q: Why did Roman soldiers build roads?
questions.a: So the army could march quickly to any part of the empire

questions.q: Big question: what made the army hard to beat?
questions.a: Training, discipline, teamwork and good equipment
